# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

**Breaking Change:** The `name` field on `/v2/users` has been split into two separate fields, `first_name` and `last_name`. Any integrations that read or write the old `name` field must be updated to use the new fields before upgrading. Responses will no longer include `name`.

**New Feature:** Added the `--incremental` flag, allowing pipelines to process only new or changed records since the last run rather than reprocessing entire datasets. This significantly reduces runtime and resource usage for recurring syncs.

**Performance:** Parquet writes are now up to 40% faster, thanks to optimizations in our serialization and buffering layer. Existing Parquet workflows benefit automatically with no configuration changes required.

Upgrade carefully and review the breaking change above before deploying.
